description: Hit the OPA `/health` endpoint. A server that answers reports `{ healthy: true }` on 200 and `{ healthy: false }` with OPA's own reason otherwise, so an unactivated bundle is a health result rather than a tool error. `OPA_UNREACHABLE` means the server could not be reached at all. Supports `bundles` and `plugins` query flags to require those subsystems to also be healthy.

bundles.description: Require bundle plugin to be healthy as well.

plugins.description: Require all plugins to be healthy.

name: opa_health
title: OPA health check
